item.title: Is This How It Ends? AARON STAINTHORPE Unsure If He’s Still the Vocalist of MY DYING BRIDE
item.description: Aaron Stainthorpe isn’t entirely sure whether he’s still the lead singer of My Dying Bride. The British doom metal band recently returned to the stage with Mikko Kotamäki, from Swallow the Sun, handling vocals.

item.title: Sharon den Adel Confirms Within Temptation’s Next Album Is Taking Shape: “We Have a Clear Vision”
item.description: So Within Temptation has a plan. Well, sort of. Sharon den Adel insists they “really have an idea what we wanna do next,” which sounds promising—until you realize that the band started with the intention of taking their sweet time, only to immediately flip-flop.

item.title: Cradle Of Filth: Ashok Šmerda and Zoë Marie Federoff marry in a gothic ceremony
item.description: Two Cradle Of Filth bandmates just got hitched. (Yes, you read that right. And it’s almost too metal to handle.) Guitarist Marek “Ashok” Šmerda and keyboardist Zoë Marie Federoff promised forever this week, and Dani Filth celebrated by posting a barrage of wedding photos for the goths, the headbangers, and everyone in between.

item.title: Cradle of Filth to Release New Single: Dani Filth Promises Fans Will "Love It"
item.description: Cradle of Filth has once again returned to the spotlight, with frontman Dani Filth making some bold claims about the band’s upcoming single, which is set to drop this October 22.

item.title: Evanescence to Begin Recording New Album in November
item.description: Evanescence—masters of gothic drama and mid-2000s radio dominance—is gearing up to record their next album. When? November. (Mark your calendars, or don’t. Your call.) The news dropped during an interview with 89 A Rádio Rock at Rock In Rio, where the band is currently melting faces.
